plain: A crown or headband worn as a sign of royal power.

webster.text: Anciently, a head-band or fillet worn by kings as a badge of royalty.

more.text: In modern usage, the mark or badge of royalty, worn on the head; a crown; and figuratively, empire; supreme power.

example.quote: He has been shown to us with the diadem sparkling on his brow and the imperial purple flowing in his train.
